jDisco
Class Graph

java.lang.Object
  jDisco.Graph

public class Graph
extends Object

This class facilitates curve plotting.

A ExtendedUnorientedGraph-object represents a graph.

An entry (x,y) is added to the graph by calling add(x,y).

The graph is shown in a frame by calling its show-method.
